newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zalakeramia advances as market rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Zalakeramia advances as market rebounds.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt rose more than one percent in early Monday trade.

Traders said that news of an acquisition by the company played a smaller role in the price rise than the fact that the Hungarian market was trying to rebound from a 140-point drop in the index on Friday.
"I think the market is coming back from Friday's bottom," one trader said, adding that the buying side seemed stronger.
"The market knew that Zalakeramia wanted to make acquisitions and now that a deal has actually been made the announcement did not trigger any price rallies."
Zalakeramia shares opened at 8,315 forints, unchanged from Friday's close, and rose to 8,425 forints by 1114 GMT.
Zalakeramia announced on Monday it had signed a deal on February 28 to acquire a 79.3 percent stake in Croatia's leading ceramics group, Inker Industria Keramike I. Porucalana D.D.
In February, Zalakeramia's shareholders approved a plan to raise the company's share capital, with details to be confirmed at a further general meeting on March 19.
The company plans to issue between 900,000 and 1.2 million new ordinary shares to finance planned acquisitions.
